name: Rational SelfCookingCenter 5 Senses Model 101 B118206.27D Liquid Propane Combi Oven - 120V
description: Whether you want to cook, steam, roast or even bake, making a wide variety of food within a single unit has never been easier than with the Rational Model 101 B118206.27D combi oven! Part of the renowned SelfCookingCenter 5 Senses series, this oven's patented SelfCookingControl offers seven convenient cooking modes so that no matter what you're making, the unit will detect product-specific requirements as well as the product size and load size to give you perfect results every time. Or, for the more experienced chef, you can take complete manual control over the cooking process with steam, convection and combination cooking modes! This B118206.27D combi oven accommodates up to ten half size sheet pans or six full size steam table pans. To make the best use of this space, the unit features an Efficient LevelControl that individually monitors each rack level so that you can cook a wide variety of foods like steaks, pizza, and veggies at the same time and with no flavor transfer, and even alarms you when each food is ready. With a durable and easy-to-clean type 304 stainless steel interior and exterior, this oven features a unique CareControl system that evaluates the level of soiling inside the unit and suggests a suitable automatic cleaning process that uses only the water and chemicals needed-no more, no less! This unit requires a 120V electrical connection and a liquid propane connection for operation. Overall Dimensions: Left to Right: 33 3/8" Front to Back: 30 1/2" Height: 41" B118206.27D From Rational

name: Avantco IC3500 Countertop Induction Range / Cooker - 208/240V, 3500W
description: This Avantco IC3500 countertop induction range delivers superior usability and performance for all your cooking needs! With innovative technology capable of heating up in as little as 1 minute, this induction burner is perfect for use in cooking applications that require quick heat up times and fast recovery such as buffet tables, banquet halls, and cruise ships. And, since there's no open flame or exposed burner, this induction unit is safer than conventional countertop ranges. Plus, this range boasts a sleek, stainless steel design for a professional look that will impress your guests, while being easy to clean. For added convenience, a built-in 180 min. timer allows you to keep track of your culinary creations, and you can cook using either a power level / wattage mode (500-3500W), or a temperature mode that ranges from 140 - 460 degrees Fahrenheit. Simply place an induction-ready pan or pot on the cooking surface and turn it on! This induction cooker is compatible with induction-ready pans that have a bottom diameter between 5" and 10 1/4". For added convenience, the cooker enters "standby" mode when the pan is removed from the surface. This unit requires a 208/240V electrical connection. Overall Dimensions: Left to Right: 12" Front to Back: 15 1/2" Height: 4 1/4" IC3500 From Avantco Equipment

name: ARY VacMaster VP210 Chamber Tabletop Vacuum Packaging Machine with 10 1/4" Seal Bar
description: The ARY VacMaster VP210 chamber tabletop vacuum packaging machine is ideal for a small commercial kitchen or deli. A chamber vacuum packaging machine like the VP210 has several advantages over traditional external bag sealers. First, the bags are of a different type, and less expensive than traditional textured bags for external bag sealers. Because what you're sealing stays in the bag instead of getting sucked into the machine, you'll be able to seal messy items like soup, gravy, or flour. Additionally, the VP210 generates a higher level of vacuum than most comparably sized machines for faster results. This VacMaster is designed for light commercial use and features a stainless steel chamber that measures 15 1/2" x 11" x 5". It also features a user-friendly control panel and a smoked lid to easily monitor the vacuum process. This item requires a 110V electrical connection, and includes 75 assorted vacuum chamber pouches, two filler plates, and a maintenance kit. Overall Dimensions: Left to Right: 14" Front to Back: 20" Height: 15" Chamber Dimensions: Left to Right: 11 1/4" Front to Back: 15 1/4" Height: 5" Seal Bar: 10 1/4" VP210 From VacMaster
